arguments.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/tmp/t1 && cd /workspace/tmp/t1 && python3 -I /app/submission/main.py compile < /app/public/config.json > prog.json; echo "exit=$?"; cat prog.json; echo; python3 - << 'EOF'
import json,subprocess,sys
p=json.load(open('prog.json'))
open('p.json','w').write(json.dumps(p))
pr=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/main.py','stream', '/workspace/tmp/t1/p.json'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
for line in open('/app/public/requests.jsonl'):
    pr.stdin.write(line.encode()); pr.stdin.flush()
    print(line.strip(), '->', pr.stdout.readline())
pr.stdin.close()
print('rest', pr.stdout.read(), pr.wait())
EOF
